{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Model BotW= File:BotW Lizal Shield Model.png |Model TotK= File:TotK Lizal Shield Model.png |Sprite BotW= File:BotW Lizal Shield Icon.png |Sprite TotK= File:TotK Lizal Shield Icon.png }} |caption= |pronunciation= |type= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC |cost= |value= |location= {{Spawn Locations}} |uses= |strength= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 15 |TotK= 15 }} |durability= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 8 |TotK= 8 }} |comp= {{List| * [[Reinforced Lizal Shield]] * [[Steel Lizal Shield]] }} |sample= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Lizal Shield|Lizal Shields|Series, BotW|plural}} are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK}} Lizal Shields go unnamed in {{AoC}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 15 |durability = 8 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Lizal Shield}} Lizal Shields are [[Shield]]s commonly found among [[Lizalfos]]. They belong to the [[Lizalfos Gear]] equipment archetype, which includes all [[Weapon]]s created by Lizalfos. The sloppy craftsmanship used to make these Shield leads to their poor [[Durability]]. They are wielded by weak [[Lizalfos]], though [[Fire-Breath Lizalfos]], [[Ice-Breath Lizalfos]], and [[Electric Lizalfos]] may also use them. All Lizal Shields are known to be made of metal. Because of this, they conduct [[Electricity]] and will [[Lightning]] if equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]]. They will also sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. However, Lizal Shields can be picked up and manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]], and they will not burn if exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. {{BotW Shield Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Shield_007" |Life = 8 |GuardPower = 15 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 1 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 2 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMax = 4 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 3 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 3 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMin = 5 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMax = 6 |RideBreakRatio = 1.0 |MirrorLevel = 0 |SurfingFriction = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 15 |durability = 8 |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Lizal Shield}} {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Lizal Shields can be wielded by [[Link]] in conjunction with [[Lizal Boomerang]]s. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Lizalfos Gear * Reinforced Lizal Shield * Shield * Steel Lizal Shield }} {{Ref| {{Cite|{{Big|Lizal Shield}}
